Commentary.Commentary: The players are out in the middle. Angelo Mathews is starting the proceedings.

Zampa was highly impressive with his leggies and broke the threatening partnership of Mendis and Chandimal by removing both of them. Perera and Mathews were handy down the order as they scored breezy half centuries. The highlight for the Aussies would be the hat-trick of Faulkner who surprised the batsmen with his intelligent change of pace. Will the Australians pull off a record chase once again in back to back matches or will the Sri Lankan spinners rule the roost? Join us after the innings break to find out!

Good comeback by Australia to keep the hosts under 300. That was a really spirited effort from the home side  though as they have posted a match winning score of 288 on the board. The pitch is pretty dry and the Lankan spinners would be licking their fingers and itching to roll their arms over. Starc was sharp with the ball as usual and struck with the new ball. Lyon was steady from the other end and sent Dishan packing. Kusal Mendis and Dinesh Chandimal joined hands and stitched together a century partnership and provided impetus to the Lankan batting. Mendis was especially brilliant once again as he bailed Sri Lanka out of trouble.

OUT! Timber! That's how you do it against a tailender! Yorker, Aponso the number 11 batsman misses it. The ball goes through and disturbs the stumps. Starc gets his third and SRI LANKA ARE ALL OUT INSIDE 50 OVERS!
Mid on comes in...
Fuller length ball outside off, Aponso goes after it but misses.
Full outside off, Aponso plays it past point for a couple to get going.
Fuller length ball outside off, Aponso fails to put his bat on the ball.

OUT! DECISION OVERTURNED! Tossed up around middle and leg, Chandimal steps down the track  to play but misses and the ball kisses his back pad and goes to the keeper who fails to grab it. Stumping chance missed but Australia take a review for a LBW. Replays show there is no inside edge. The Hawk Eye shows that the impact is in line and the ball would have crashed into the stumps. The decision is overturned and Chandimal departs! What a fantastic review by the Aussies!

FOUR! That's a good shot from Dilshan! Shortish ball around off, Dilshan gets into position quickly and pulls it confidently through mid-wicket and the ball whistles away to the boundary!
In a similar channel, shapes away this time. Dilshan again swings at it wildly and misses it completely.
Fullish delivery outside off, swings in a bit. Dilshan has a wild swing at it and is lucky to get away with it. Poor shot from Dilshan!
Around off, Dilshan taps it to the off side for a quick single to get off the mark. Good over by Lyon as well.
On middle and off, flicked away to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Flighted on off, Gunathilaka drives it to mid off.
Fullish ball outside off, Gunathilaka drives it uppishly to point.

NOT OUT! Tossed up outside off, Gunathilaka looks to push but misses it completely. Wade collects the ball and whips off the bails in a flash and appeals for a stumping. The umpire refers it upstairs and replays confirm the batsman is safe as he never took his back foot out of the crease.
Appeal for a stumping referred upstairs...
Flighted around off, Gunathilaka looks to play it across but gets a leading edge back to the bowler.
Nathan Lyon to bowl from the other end.
Full delivery directed at the stumps. Dilshan drives it back to the bowler. That's a great first over from Starc and he kept the openers guessing with his intelligent variations in lines and lengths.
On a length outside off, Dilshan pushes it to covers.
That's a peach of a delivery! Full ball just outside off, swinging away. Dilshan plays at it and misses it completely.
Back of a length ball outside off, zips off the pitch. Dilshan pokes at it and is beaten comprehensively.
Full ball around off, Gunathilaka pushes it to the covers and sets off for a run. Warner is quick to get to the ball and throws at the non striker's end. Gunathilaka makes it safely in the end.
Good length ball outside off, seams away a bit with good bounce. Gunathilaka plays at it and gets beaten. That's a good start from Starc!
Mitchell Starc is going to start the proceedings for Australia. He got a wicket in the first over in the previous ODI. Can he do it again? Here we go...
The players are out in the middle and it promises to be a riveting contest. Dilshan and Gunathilaka are going to open the batting for Sri Lanka.

Team changes - Seekkuge Prasanna comes in for Lakshan Sandakan and Danushka Gunathilaka makes the team in place of Milinda Siriwardana. The Australians have made one change in their side in the form of Nathan Lyon who comes in for Josh Hazlewood.
SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT!

Hello and a warm welcome to the 2nd ODI between Sri Lanka and Australia at the R. Premadasa Stadium, Colombo. The Aussies would be riding high on confidence after registering their best chase against the Lankans in their own den. Finch and Smith led from the front and ensured that the visiting side sailed to victory. It was an impressive performance from the Kangaroos but the home side gave them a tough fight. Let's see how the hosts fight back today.
